name: SDoH HRSN
remarks: Replaces src/main/resources/modules/encounter/sdoh_hrsn.json (the PRAPARE social needs screening of the wellness visits) with a module that does nothing. Load it with -d config/common/modules.

The original only writes output: the PRAPARE questionnaire, the screening procedure and 20 findings (employment, education, housing, transport, stress, social isolation and others), from attributes set elsewhere. It sets 19 attributes of its own (prapare_*, household_size) and no other module or Java code reads them or the findings. The wellness encounter module and hiv/hiv_baseline call it as a submodule, and an empty module is a valid submodule.
